title: MMC_BUILTIN:sfdi2layer
description: Spatial-frequency-domain imaging (SFDI) of a two-layer tissue slab using mesh-based Monte Carlo (MMC): a 40x40x35 mm tetrahedral mesh (21664 nodes, 130221 tets) illuminated by a wide-field spatially-modulated (fourier) source. InitElem is -1, demonstrating mmc automatic enclosing-element search; runs the dual-grid DMMC ray tracer for voxel output.
